content: To set the wakeup sources up for the next sleep mode, the ECU Manager module shall execute the EcuM_EnableWakeupSources callout (see [SWS_EcuM_02546] ) for each wakeup source that is configured in EcuMWakeup- SourceMask for the target sleep mode.

To set the wakeup sources up for the next sleep mode, the ECU Manager module shall execute the EcuM_EnableWakeupSources callout (see [SWS_EcuM_02546] ) for each wakeup source that is configured in EcuMWakeup- SourceMask for the target sleep mode.

To set the wakeup sources up for the next sleep mode, the ECU Manager module shall execute the EcuM_EnableWakeupSources callout (see [SWS_EcuM_02546] ) for each wakeup source that is configured in EcuMWakeup- SourceMask for the target sleep mode.
